# Penniless Parenting

> A practical guide to frugal living, budget travel, and parenting wisdom from Penny Price's real-world family experiences.

Penniless Parenting is a long-running blog by Penny Price that shares actionable strategies for raising a family on a tight budget while traveling and maintaining mental wellness. The site combines personal family stories with practical tips on money-saving, DIY projects, and child development.

## Key Topics

- frugal living
- budget travel
- parenting tips
- family budgeting
- mental health
- DIY projects
- homemade recipes
- child development
- family education
- personal finance
- parenting blog
- blog monetization
- family stories
- Penny Price
- STEM education

## About & Community

- [Penniless Parenting Homepage](https://pennilessparenting.com): Main hub for frugal living and family education resources by Penny Price.
- [All About This Blog](https://pennilessparenting.com/all-about-this-blog): Blog history and author's financial journey that inspired Penniless Parenting.
- [Meet The Price Family](https://pennilessparenting.com/meet-the-price-family): Introduction to Penny Price's family background and personal story across multiple locations including London, Cleveland, and New York City.
- [Contact Me](https://pennilessparenting.com/contact-me): Reader engagement and feedback channel at pennilessparenting@yahoo.com.
